objective_for_doctor: Assess and manage a 40-year-old woman who has presented with weakness and weight loss, and interpret her laboratory findings to make a diagnosis.

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Doctor: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: Over the last few months I’ve been feeling weaker and I’ve had unintentional weight loss without changing my diet or exercise. I also want to make sure my kidney function is okay because of my family history of kidney disease.
[ASK] Have you been diagnosed with (or do you currently have) chronic kidney disease (e.g., reduced kidney function or persistent abnormal kidney tests)?
“No, I haven’t been diagnosed with chronic kidney disease, and I don’t know of any abnormal kidney test results so far.” “That’s why I’m concerned given my family history.”
[ASK] Have you had a persistent cough with shortness of breath that is worse with exertion and/or smoking history?
Patient: No, I haven’t had a persistent cough or shortness of breath with exertion, and I don’t smoke.
